title: Why Garrus Vakarian quit C-Sec in Mass Effect
subject: garrus
description:
Would you have quit C-Sec too? 👇

How a frustrated Citadel cop became Commander Shepard's closest ally. Spoilers for Mass Effect (2007).

scenes.text: Garrus Vakarian was a cop who hated following the rules.
In 2183 he worked for C-Sec on the Citadel, investigating a turian Spectre named Saren Arterius.
His bosses shut the case down. His father, a C-Sec veteran, always did things by the book.
Garrus kept digging and followed a lead to Dr. Chloe Michel's clinic, where thugs held her at gunpoint.
One clean shot ended the standoff, just as Commander Shepard walked in.
Soon after, he quit C-Sec and joined the Normandy's crew.
The cop who hated rules had found someone willing to break them.
